artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1773: The Temple of Peace
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi, after Giuseppe Palazzi, after Paolo Posi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure depicted as a ceremonial temple. The drawing shows a grand temple with a large central arch and supporting columns, decorated with statues and bas-reliefs. The temple features a domed roof and statues atop the structure. The composition includes elements like draped flags and sculptural figures. In the foreground, figures and horse-drawn carriages are present, indicating the significance of the architecture. The scene is rendered in fine line work, capturing details of the architectural features and environment.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1773: The Preparation of Theriac in Venice
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi, after Giuseppe Palazzi, after Paolo Posi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural structure with ornamental details and people gathered around. The image depicts an impressive and grandiose architectural facade, detailed with intricate sculptures and decorative elements. The structure resembles a triumphal arch or a ceremonial altar, with steps leading up to it and columns flanking the entrance. In front of the structure, there are groups of people, some standing and others engaged in conversation or a ceremonial procession. The background shows part of a ship with visible masts and sails. The scene is rendered in monochrome, emphasizing the lines and shading that give the drawing depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1774: Hercules and the Dragon in the Garden of the Hesperides
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi, after Giuseppe Palazzi, after Paolo Posi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene. The artwork features a detailed facade of a building with classical architectural elements like columns, arches, and statues. The building is set on an elevated platform with stairs leading to the main entrance. Sculptures adorn the roof and balustrades. Figures in the foreground are engaged in various activities, contributing to a narrative. Dramatic cloud formations fill the sky behind the structure.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1774: A Villa with Ancient Monuments and a Game of "Giostra"
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi, after Giuseppe Palazzi, after Paolo Posi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The image features a grand architectural façade adorned with statues and ornate details. The façade has three archways, each housing a statue, and is flanked by columns and moldings. Sculptures and decorative urns sit atop the structure. In front, figures are depicted in various poses. The structure is set against a partially cloudy sky. The engravings and architectural style reflect neoclassical influences.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1775: A Bull-fight
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi, after Giuseppe Palazzi, after Paolo Posi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a symmetrical architectural drawing of a Baroque building with multiple levels. The high horizon line provides a detailed view of the façade and activities below. The building features statues, arches, and decorations, with fine brushstrokes creating textures and shading. Figures and animals are depicted in action near the viewer, contrasting with the building's grandeur. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia or brown tones. Wispy clouds are etched in the sky above the building.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1776: A Pleasure Palace
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image displays an architectural scene from a straight-on point of view. It features a grand, ornate building atop wide steps. The horizon is defined by the top of the structure, with a decorative element possibly depicting a figure on a chariot. Large urns on both sides emit what appear to be fountains of water or smoke, creating a symmetrical effect. The composition is rendered in an engraved style with fine, detailed line work depicting the texture and detail of the architecture and surrounding elements. The image uses a monochromatic palette of sepia tones to create depth and contrast. Figures dressed in period clothing are engaged in activities near the building, emphasizing its grandeur. Intricate details of the architecture and landscape can be seen in the distance, adding complexity to the scene.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1776: A Palace with a Loggia for the Lottery Draw
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an opulently decorated palace facade. The image depicts a grand architectural structure with a central tower featuring an ornate clock, surrounded by sculpted figures and elaborate baroque decorations. The palace is flanked by symmetrical structures and adorned with various sculptures and draperies. Architectural arches and columns add to the magnificence of the palace, while steps lead up to the main building. The engraving shows groups of people engaged in a form of pageantry or procession at the foot of the building, creating a sense of celebration and historical grandeur. The intricate lines and shading capture the luxuriously ornamental baroque style, indicative of an era of lavish architecture and celebration.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1778: A Countryside Belevedere with Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows an elaborate architectural structure with multiple levels, staircases, fountains, statues, and a central dome topped with an eagle. The intricate engraving lines depict the detailed design. The monochrome color palette enhances the depth and texture. Figures, a horse-drawn cart, and groups of people are depicted throughout the scene. Sculpted hedges and trees frame the central elements. The background has a textured pattern resembling a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1778: A Dwelling near Monte Testaccio
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image depicts a grand architectural façade with a mountainous backdrop. The structure features detailed arches and classical columns, set against a steep hill or mountain where small figures are ascending. The foreground shows activity, including horse-drawn carts and individuals. The structure has intricate rooftop decoration, including statues, vases, and greenery.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1782: The Temple of Janus Built by Numa Pompilius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image is an architectural drawing of a grand temple-like structure viewed from the front at a slightly elevated angle. The temple has a prominent central entrance with steps and tall columns on each side. Statues decorate the top of the structure, including a figure at the peak. The horizon is low, emphasizing the building's height. Trees can be seen in the background, adding depth to the scene. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching for shadows and textures, typical of engravings. The color scheme is mainly brown and sepia tones. Closest to the temple, figures are engaged in various activities, adding scale and human presence to the scene.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1782: A Countryside Festival at Night
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate architectural structure with a grand staircase. People are seen on the staircase. The setting is surrounded by lush vegetation, obscuring the horizon. The image is created using engraving technique with detailed line work and shading. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. Trees are visible in the distance near the building. Elegantly dressed individuals are gathered on the staircase. The sky is depicted with delicate hatching.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1785: The Temple of Jupiter Begun by Tarquinius Priscus with the Marvel of Accius Naevius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate temple facade. The artwork displays a detailed architectural structure with classical elements. The temple is topped with sculptures of figures holding spears and mythical creatures, sitting atop a multi-tiered structure. The building is supported by a series of fluted columns with Corinthian capitals. An ornate frieze and pediment adorn the facade, and various relief sculptures can be seen decorating the temple walls. The presence of various artfully executed figures, both sculpted and engraved, adds depth and richness to the portrayal. The temple sits atop a grand staircase, with figures dispersed throughout the steps, suggesting a sense of scale and liveliness. At the base of the stairs, several individuals and groups interact, conveying a sense of community life. The details suggest the drawing serves both an artistic and educational purpose, showcasing the grandeur and complexity of classical architecture.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1785: A Pleasure Palace with an Air Balloon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Vincent Buonanno in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The image shows a grand building with multiple tiers, columns, and intricate sculptures. The facade is decorated with numerous statues and ornate designs. A large spherical object is situated in the center of the composition, adorned with detailed architectural elements. Peacocks are depicted atop urns on raised pedestals at either side of the structure. Surrounding the central focus are various figures engaged in different activities, creating a lively scene. The foreground includes more figures, a donkey, and Italian text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le bal masqué - Fête donnée à l'occasion de la naissance de Monseigneur le Dauphin, 23 janvier 1782
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Prouté Family in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballroom scene. The image shows an interior space with grand architectural elements like towering columns, high ceilings, ornate windows with draperies, and multiple chandeliers. A large gathering occupies the room, suggesting a social event or dance. The walls are decorated, and in the background, detailed facades resemble an opulent palace or theatrical backdrop. Figures in period costume are depicted, possibly indicating a historical or celebratory occasion.

artworks.title: Le festin royal - Fête donnée à l'occasion de la naissance de Monseigneur le Dauphin, 21 janvier 1782
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Prouté Family in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand hall filled with elegantly dressed figures at a gathering. The scene captures an event taking place in a lavishly decorated interior space, featuring a high ceiling adorned with chandeliers and garlands. The hall is lined with large windows draped with curtains, and the architecture is rich with intricate details and classical motifs. The assembly of figures appears to be engaged in conversation and various social activities, creating a lively and bustling atmosphere. The drawing is meticulous in its depiction of both architectural elements and the finery of the attendees' attire, reflecting a setting of historical opulence and grandeur.

artworks.title: Rue de la Vieille lanterne (The Suicide of Gérard de Nerval)
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Prouté Family in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This print features an underground environment with skeletal and ghostly figures. Near the bottom-right corner of the print, a man appears to slump against a wall. A pale ghost seems to emerge from him. Above the ghost, a skeleton stands on the top of a set of stairs, seeming to blow a long trumpet. Across the top of the scene is an enormous group of pale, ghostly figures in a dreamlike haze.

artworks.title: Italian Landscape with Fortifications and a Waterfall
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Ahmanson Foundation and Edward E. MacCrone Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketched in a monochromatic palette of greys and blacks, with a textured quality. There are dense clusters of foliage in the foreground, detailed leaves frame the edges. In the middle ground, there is a body of water, possibly a river. In the distance, there is a castle or grand building on a hill, surrounded by woods. The style features delicate lines capturing textures of leaves, trees, and rocky cliff faces.

artworks.title: Biscuits Lefèvre-Utile
artworks.medium: color lithograph on paper laid down on linen
artworks.creditLine: Evelyn Stefansson Nef Fund
artworks.description: This print depicts a woman seated with her body turned slightly to the right. She is facing us with a slight smile, and raises one hand out to the right, holding a plate of biscuits. She has light skin, rosy cheeks, and long, wavy blonde hair. She wears an off-shoulder light blue dress with a pink ribbon decorated with crescent patterns. She has a wreath of large red flowers on her head. The background is in shades of light blue, green, yellow, and cream, with an arched border at the top in red with golden swirls. At the bottom is what appears to be a calendar for 1897 designed in a semicircular fan shape. The text above the woman's head reads "Biscuits Lefèvre-Utile" in red text on a white background.

artworks.title: Horse-drawn Carriage and Female Rider
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals and horses in an outdoor setting. A carriage pulled by two horses is in the center, with an individual seated inside wearing period attire. Two people stand next to the horses, both dressed in coats and top hats. Another individual, a woman, is seated sidesaddle on one of the horses. The background features greenery with large trees and bushes, suggesting a park or garden. The image has a vintage sepia tone.

artworks.title: Army Train and Death
artworks.medium: woodcut from four blocks, on four sheets
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military procession featuring soldiers, animals, and equipment moving in unison. The scene is detailed with figures in a parade-like formation. The soldiers are equipped with lances, shields, and helmets, and march alongside horses and camels carrying equipment. The drawing uses linework to depict movement and dynamics of the figures, conveying the sense of a grand procession. The composition is balanced, highlighting the unity of the march. The artwork showcases historical military regalia and the grandeur of a mobilized force.

artworks.title: Daniel's Vision
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ramón Osuna
artworks.description: This drawing shows various hybrid creatures rising from the sea. A cloaked figure stands in the water to the left. The scene depicts creatures with wings, claws, and muscular limbs emerging from the waves. One creature has the body of a bear with wings, while others show attributes of a lion and a tiger. The background includes swirling clouds and a partially visible celestial body, enhancing the dramatic effect. The artwork is highly detailed, with strong shading emphasizing textures like fur, feathers, and water.

artworks.title: Death of the Doe
artworks.medium: mezzotint on wove paper [proof before color]
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 39.7 × 49.4 cm (15 5/8 × 19 7/16 in.), trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Krugman Family in Honor of J. Sylvia Krugman and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a slightly crouched posture interacting with two dogs in a forest setting. The man has a rounded face and short, neatly styled hair. He is wearing a light-colored shirt with a necktie, pants, and a coat. A rifle is on the ground beside him. The background is filled with trees, foliage, plants, and rocks.

artworks.title: Wierd-Sisters; Ministers of Darkness; Minions of the Moon
artworks.medium: etching, engraving and aquatint printed in sepia on wove paper, with publisher's hand-coloring and inscriptions by Gillray
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous Gift
artworks.description: The image shows the profiles of three individuals positioned closely together, gazing ahead. Each person has distinct facial features. The first person has a prominent nose and wears a patterned shawl, the second person has delicate features with rosy cheeks and gray hair styled backward, while the third person has a long, slender nose and thick eyebrows, with voluminous, curly hair and a beard. They wear cloaks. The background features a cloudy, moonlit sky with a large moon visible in the distance. The scene is set at night.

artworks.title: Et vidi alium angelum fortem... (The Angel of the Apocalypse Appearing to Saint John)
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous in memory of Gaillard Ravenel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, majestic winged figure emerging from clouds with a kneeling bearded figure extending a hand towards the first figure. The central figure is depicted with well-defined musculature and expansive wings, and the scene is set among dramatic clouds. At the lower right, the kneeling figure, dressed in draped garments, looks up with its hands clasped. The extensive use of shading and line work adds texture and volume, creating a dramatic interplay of light and shadow throughout the piece.
